_about: Everyday Decoded, layout C 'labelled diagram' (Irfan 27 Nov 2026): a how-it-works look. Hero with a teal blueprint-grid tint on its edges, the hook in a white rounded speech-bubble card at the top-left (setup charcoal #1B1F24, payoff deep teal #00796E, teal accent bar), and thin white callout lines with teal-ringed dots from 2-3 parts of the object to small charcoal rounded labels (--callout 'x,y:LABEL[@lx,ly]', repeatable; --sticker still works as an amber pill). Rotate A->B->C per Page.
